::: {style="text-align: center;"}
My name is Andrew Kates. I work as a Sport Scientist at the Canadian Sport Institute Pacific in Whistler, British Columbia, Canada. I am also a PhD student in Biomechanics at the [University of Victoria](https://www.uvic.ca/). On this website you will find my blog, in which I will write primarily about Strength and Conditioning and practical Data Science for sport.
:::
